title: Find Minimum Cost to Remove Array Elements
summary: Given an integer array nums, repeatedly remove elements by selecting and removing any two from the first three elements at each step, with the cost being the maximum of the two removed.
statement: Given an integer array nums, repeatedly remove elements by selecting and removing any two from the first three elements at each step, with the cost being the maximum of the two removed. If fewer than three elements remain, remove them all in one operation with the cost being the maximum of those remaining. The goal is to find the minimum total cost to remove all elements.
constraints: nums is a nonempty positive-integer array.
While at least three remain, remove any two of the first three and pay their maximum.
When fewer than three remain, remove all and pay their maximum; minimize total cost.
hints: After each operation, exactly one of the first three survives to join the next two untouched values.
Memoize by the next untouched index and the surviving value.
Try keeping each of the three candidates, add the maximum of the removed pair, and recurse two positions forward; handle one or two leftovers directly.
The state contains the full remaining prefix information, and the three transitions exhaust every legal removal choice.
editorial: The state contains the full remaining prefix information, and the three transitions exhaust every legal removal choice.

tests.explanation: Choosing which value survives the first operation yields a minimum total cost of twelve.
Fewer than three values remain, so remove both once at cost two.
